description.from: Design and test a taper rule driven by recorded metrics rather than a fixed schedule. Candidate rule: review everything until the last-200 calibration error is below 0.05 and auto-approved accuracy at the chosen threshold has met the target for two consecutive 100-cycle windows; then lower the review rate one step (100, 50, 35, 25, 15 percent), holding at least a 5 percent random audit; step back up if either metric fails for a window. Compare against fixed rates and against a time-based taper. Measure labels spent, whole-system accuracy, and worst-window accuracy. Acceptance: the rule implemented as a replay feedback policy with its parameters recorded, one recording per variant, and a recommendation.
